source.manual: Beispiel – ersetzt durch echtes Lexmark Service-Manual

errors.title: Fuser error – temperature low
errors.action: Check the fuser connection. Replace the fuser assembly.

errors.title: Fuser error
errors.action: Turn the printer off and on. Replace the fuser assembly.

errors.title: Paper jam in tray 2 – media failed to reach sensor
errors.action: Check tray 2 for obstructions. Replace the tray 2 pick roller assembly.

errors.title: Imaging unit missing or defective
errors.action: Reinstall the imaging unit. Replace the imaging unit.

errors.title: Print quality: toner smears or rubs off the page
errors.action: Check media type settings. Replace the fuser assembly.

errors.title: Print quality: vertical streaks or lines
errors.action: Clean the printhead lenses. Replace the imaging unit. Replace the transfer belt.

errors.title: Paper jam in duplex area
errors.action: Remove jammed paper. Replace the duplex unit.

errors.title: System software error
errors.action: Update the firmware. Replace the main controller board.
